label: Timeline A — canonical EH arc (low → peak breakthrough → settle)
notes: Primary POC arm. Energy peaks at Breakthrough.

phases.name: Opening
phases.musical_intent: sparse piano and soft pads; space and breath; almost still

phases.name: Challenge
phases.musical_intent: low strings enter; unresolved harmony; held tension under calm surface

phases.name: Struggle
phases.musical_intent: denser texture; restless ostinato; percussion hints; rising pressure without release

phases.name: Turning Point
phases.emotional_state: small act of service cracks the isolation
phases.musical_intent: harmonic shift toward light; melody fragment appears; forward motion begins

phases.name: Breakthrough
phases.musical_intent: full warm ensemble; elevated dynamics; triumphant but human; peak of the arc

phases.name: Resolution
phases.emotional_state: quiet resolve to keep showing up
phases.musical_intent: texture thins; piano returns; warm settled cadence; leave space
